I mean i have come to know that if i wish to concieve and have sex twice in the same night i have to perform gusal in between please help. Question: Assalamu alaikum, Is it necessary to have gusal before having sex for conception. I mean i have come to know that if i wish to concieve and have sex twice in the same night i have to perform gusal in between please help. Answer ID: 7247 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 858/858=M/1429) It is not necessary, but it is mustahab (desirable) to do ghusl or wudhu in between two intercourses at a night. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
